projectDescription: A Roblox horror-survival game built in Luau where survivors face off against killers across multiple maps and gamemodes, featuring a modular character system, server-authoritative hitboxes, anticheat, and a custom networking layer.
keyFeatures: Killer vs. Survivor asymmetric gameplay with multiple gamemodes (Classic, Double Trouble, Powerhouse, One Bounce)
Modular character system with per-character Config + Manager + Ability files
Server-authoritative hitbox system with client-side snapshots for latency compensation
DeltaNetwork custom networking layer with type validation, rate limiting, and middleware
Initializer lifecycle system (Init → Start) for module loading on both server and client
Status effects engine supporting Bleed, Blindness, Burning, Slowness, Stunned, Poisoned, and more
Built-in anticheat with checks for speed hacking, flying, noclipping, flinging, and backshotting
ProfileStore-based persistent player data (fragments, equipped characters, keybind settings)
17 selectable maps with per-map lighting configs and optional objectives
Large cosmetic catalog: 70+ emotes and dozens of character skins
publicApiSurface: Initializer:LoadModules(moduleScripts, bucketName, options) — bulk-require and lifecycle-call a set of ModuleScripts
DeltaNetwork (Delta) — create/send/receive typed RemoteEvent and RemoteFunction wrappers
Anticheat.new(config) — instantiate anticheat with configurable checks and OnViolation callback
Anticheat:RegisterCheck(name, module) — plug in a custom movement/exploit check
RoundHandler — orchestrates intermission, map loading, actor spawning, and round-end via RoundUtil sub-modules
DataHandler.Template — player data schema (Fragments, EquippedActors, settings, keybinds)
Character Config schema — Info, Class, MaxHealth, SprintConfig, AbilityInfo, ChaseConfig, Sounds, Animations
Ability Server/Client split — each ability exposes a Server.luau and Client.luau loaded by the character Manager
Gamemode interface — Name, MinPlayers, RoundTime, StartRound(context, session), optional ApplyActorModifiers
